*Sanidassanattika, Cūḷantaraduka* is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna section of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Structured according to the analytical framework of the Paṭṭhāna, the text investigates conditional relations by combining the triplet of visible phenomena (*sanidassanattika*) with the dyads of the lesser intermediate pairs (*cūḷantaraduka*) [SuttaCentral].
DharmaNexus identifies extensive formulaic text reuse between this work and other Abhidhamma treatises, recording 761 matching passages shared across 109 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The closest textual parallels occur within related combinatorial sections of the Paṭṭhāna, particularly *Sanidassanattika, Dassanenapahātabbadukādi* (Patthana 22.35; 86 matches, with §5.1–8.1 sharing material with §15.1–18.1_0), *Sanidassanattika, Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 22.32; 58 matches), and *Sanidassanattika, Āsavagocchaka* (Patthana 22.30; 43 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Across language traditions, DharmaNexus registers two low-scoring automated alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Yogācārabhūmiviniścayasaṃgrahanī* (D4038), though these represent machine alignments rather than historically curated parallels [DharmaNexus].
